regulatory_descriptor: A Non Linked, Non Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan
variants: Whole of Life (cover up to age 99)
key_benefits: Death Benefit — Sum Assured paid to nominee/legal heir on death of Life Assured; policy terminates
Maturity Benefit (Return of Premium) — total premiums paid returned as lump sum ONLY if ROP option chosen; NIL if ROP not chosen
Optional Critical Illness Benefit (CIB) with separate CI Sum Assured — Minor CI 25% (Angioplasty lower of Rs 5 Lacs or 25%), Major CI 100%, max four Minor CI claims
Whole of Life cover up to age 99 (only with limited premium payment; not available with ROP)
Policy loan up to 50% of Surrender Value — ONLY if ROP feature opted and policy has acquired Surrender Value

eligibility.policy_term: Whole of Life option covers up to age 99; exact PT range not captured in this parse
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Limited (5, 10, 15, 20, Pay-till-60; max PPT cessation age 75) or Regular; for Limited+ROP minimum PT-minus-PPT difference is 5 years
eligibility.note: Eligibility age/sum-assured boundary table not recovered from this leaflet parse — verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: Free-look period not explicitly captured in this leaflet parse; standard 30 days expected — verify against policy document.
key_terms.grace_period: Not explicitly captured in this leaflet parse; on non-payment policy lapses (no ROP) or converts to paid-up (with ROP, after at least one full year's premium).
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not explicitly captured in this leaflet parse — verify against policy document.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Maturity Benefit (return of total premiums paid) applies ONLY if the Return of Premium (ROP) option is chosen at inception; if ROP not chosen, Maturity Benefit is NIL (pure term). ROP and Whole of Life cannot both be chosen.
key_terms.loan_condition: Policy loan (up to 50% of Surrender Value, current interest 10% p.a. compounding half-yearly) is available ONLY if ROP feature opted and the policy has acquired Surrender Value.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per prevailing tax laws' — GST/applicable taxes extra and subject to change; consult a tax advisor.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Disclaimer — sales literature gives salient features only; policy document is conclusive

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'get your premiums back' / 'return of premium' / 'maturity benefit' claim is valid ONLY when the ROP option is chosen — must be option-qualified; base Life Cover pays NO maturity benefit.
Any 'whole life / cover up to age 99' claim is valid ONLY with the limited-premium Whole of Life option, and is NOT available together with ROP.
Any 'take a loan against your policy' claim is valid ONLY when ROP is opted and Surrender Value has been acquired.
Critical Illness payouts are option-bound (separate CI Sum Assured, waiting/survival periods) — Minor CI pays 25% (Angioplasty capped), Major CI 100%, max four Minor CI claims.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as an investment, savings or wealth-creation product — it is non-linked, non-participating term protection (the savings element is only return-of-premium, not growth).
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — there are no bonuses (non-par); the only money-back is return-of-premium on the ROP option.
Do NOT present the base term cover as paying a maturity amount.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non Linked, Non Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions

gaps: numeric entry/maturity age, minimum sum-assured and free-look/grace/suicide specifics not recovered from this leaflet parse
